chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: The private part of the believer is only that which is between the navel and the knees.
And for the woman, it is that which is between the navel and the knees, except the center.

key_terms.عَوْرَة: Private part or area of the body that must be covered

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of awrah (private parts) for men and women in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to establish the fundamental boundaries of *awrah* (modesty) during Salah, distinguishing between the minimum requirements for men and the more comprehensive coverage for women. This definition serves as the baseline for fiqh discussions on prayer validity, with Shia jurists often debating whether the 'center' exclusion for women implies a narrower requirement or refers to specific anatomical nuances in the context of prostration.
